subject: Vendor onboarding: security package, DPA & PO instructions
messages:
From: Michelle Torres <michelle@lumencloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumencloud.com
Date: 2027-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: initial request for security docs & PO routing

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. LumenCloud is excited to get set up with Redwood. Procurement asked me to send the standard onboarding materials so your team can validate security/compliance and kick off PO setup. Attached is what we typically provide: DPA (signed), SOC 2 public report link, and a csv of our subprocessor partners.

Could you confirm the following so we can return any missing evidence quickly?
- Where to upload signed DPA (DocuSign or vendor portal).
- Whether Redwood needs the full SOC 2 report or the public summary link is sufficient.
- PO remit/payment instructions and any invoice formatting requirements (PO number format, tax id on invoice).
- Expected SLA for enabling production access once PO is in place.

Attachments: Lumen_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf (signed copy), Lumen_SOC2_public_report_link.txt (URL), Lumen_subprocessors_list.csv

Thanks — I can jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Michelle Torres
Head of Revenue Operations
LumenCloud Solutions
michelle@lumencloud.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Torres <michelle@lumencloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial request for security docs & PO routing

Hi Michelle — thanks for sending everything over so promptly. Quick confirmation and next steps from our side:

Summary of what we received:
- Signed DPA (attached) — good first step.
- SOC 2 public link — we'll need to validate whether the summary is sufficient; legal may request the full report under NDA.
- Subprocessor list CSV — thanks.

What we need from you to create a PO:
- Vendor legal name exactly as it should appear on the PO + W-9 or tax-equivalent (for US vendors).
- Billing remit address and preferred payment method (ACH vs. wire).
- Example invoice with line items (attached proforma looks fine).

Legal note: looping in Aditya (Legal) to confirm DPA acceptance or any redlines. Monica from Supplier Ops is copied to begin the PO workflow and vendor portal activation.

Upload options: we accept signed agreements via DocuSign (link in my next email) or direct upload to our vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/activate?vendor=lumencloud

If Legal requires the full SOC 2 report, we can send an NDA before they upload it to our secure evidence bucket.

Target timeline: if tax info + invoice arrive today, Finance aims to issue a PO within 3 business days (Net30 on standard terms unless otherwise negotiated). I will confirm PO number when issued.

Thanks — cc'ing Ben from Finance for PO timing.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Michelle Torres <michelle@lumencloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumencloud.com
Date: 2027-06-05T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial request for security docs & PO routing

Vivek — attaching the documents you asked for.

Attachments in this message: Lumen_DPA_Signed_v1.pdf, Lumen_SOC2_public_report_link.txt (contains https://lumencloud.com/security/soc2-report-2027), Lumen_subprocessors_list.csv, Lumen_Proforma_Invoice_0527.pdf

Vendor legal name: LumenCloud Solutions, Inc.
Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
Remit address: 200 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107
Preferred payment: ACH (US). Bank details will be provided on the vendor portal secure form or on the invoice.

If you need the full SOC 2 report we can place it behind an NDA on our shared S3 link — happy to sign.

Let me know if anything else is required to prevent PO delays.

Thanks,
Michelle

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Torres <michelle@lumencloud.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial request for security docs & PO routing

Michelle / Vivek — thanks for the uploads and the clear vendor info. A few legal checks and requests before we finalize:

1) DPA: I reviewed the signed DPA you attached. The template is largely acceptable, but we need confirmation on two narrow points:
   - Subprocessor notification cadence (Section 4.2) — we prefer 30 days' notice for new subprocessors; if you provide a standard attestation cadence, please confirm.
   - Data deletion vs. return language (Section 6) — please confirm you can support deletion upon contract termination for Redwood data.

2) SOC 2: The public report link is fine for initial review. If our risk team requests the full report, we'll send an NDA. Please advise whether a restricted/IRS-style report is available for secure sharing.

3) Subprocessors: The CSV looks comprehensive; please add the primary cloud provider region (AWS us-west-2 / GCP us-central etc.) for each subprocessor row so our infra team can map data residency.

Once those items are confirmed we can clear legal hold and Monica/Ben can proceed with PO creation. Ben — if ACH is the method, could you confirm any additional fields you need on the invoice (bank remit fields, Swift/BIC if non-US) so Michelle can add them to the vendor portal entry?

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Torres <michelle@lumencloud.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial request for security docs & PO routing

Thanks all — short checklist to close this thread and keep timelines clear:

Michelle:
- Please confirm subprocessor notification cadence (Aditya's point).
- Add cloud region column to the subprocessor CSV and re-upload to the portal OR attach here.
- If full SOC 2 is requested, we'll send NDA; otherwise the public link will usually suffice for ops review.

Redwood Ops/Finance (internal):
- Monica to open vendor record and mark vendor as "Pending PO" once updated CSV is received.
- Ben to prepare PO once vendor record is complete and invoice is valid. Target PO issue: EOD 2027-06-10 if Michelle provides missing items today.

We will proceed with standard Net30 terms. If LumenCloud needs an expedited payment window or different terms, please flag ASAP.

Michelle — appreciate the fast turnaround. If you want me to set a 15-min sync tomorrow to clear outstanding items, say the time and I'll jump on it.

Best,
Vivek
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
